name: number-field
title: Number Field
description: A number input on Base UI's NumberField with steppers that speed up while held, digits that roll on every step, Intl formatting with a true minus, min, max and step, and an optional scrub label.
docs: Import NumberField from components/eased/number-field/number-field; give it a label, or wrap it in Field. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import.
